Class TaskController

java.lang.Object
com.devops.tasks.TaskController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1/tasks") public class TaskController extends Object
REST Controller for Task management operations. Base path: /api/v1/tasks

  • Method Details

    • getAllTasks

      @GetMapping public List<Task> getAllTasks(@RequestParam(required=false) String assignedTo)
      Retrieve all tasks or tasks assigned to a specific user (via query param). Example: GET /api/v1/tasks?assignedTo=userA

    • getTaskById

      @GetMapping("/{id}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Task> getTaskById(@PathVariable String id)
      Retrieve a specific task by ID. Example: GET /api/v1/tasks/{taskId}

    • createTask

      @PostMapping @ResponseStatus(CREATED) public Task createTask(@RequestBody Task task)
      Create a new task. Example: POST /api/v1/tasks Body: { "title": "New Task", "description": "Details", "assignedToUserId": "userB" }

    • updateTask

      @PutMapping("/{id}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Task> updateTask(@PathVariable String id, @RequestBody Task taskDetails)
      Update an existing task (e.g., changing status or assigned user). Example: PUT /api/v1/tasks/{taskId} Body: { "status": "DONE" }

    • deleteTask

      @DeleteMapping("/{id}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> deleteTask(@PathVariable String id)
      Delete a task by ID. Example: DELETE /api/v1/tasks/{taskId}

    • deleteTasksByUserId

      @DeleteMapping("/users/{userId}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> deleteTasksByUserId(@PathVariable String userId)
      Delete all tasks assigned to a specific user. Example: DELETE /api/v1/tasks/users/{userId}
      Parameters:
      userId - The ID of the user whose assigned tasks should be deleted
      Returns:
      204 No Content if tasks were deleted, 404 Not Found if no tasks were found for the user
